note: Queries of the big-dimension variant of the engine bench (`engine-bench gen --variant bigdim`; docs/benchmarks.md, section "Big dimension and skewed data"): the standard star schema plus a Client dimension of millions of rows (Client, Segment, Ville, Pays, TrancheAge, Fidelite) related to Ventes[ClientKey]. Shapes of report visuals filtered by the dimension's attributes, as Desktop writes them. Every query has a full ORDER BY, or a single row.

queries.title: Segment slicer (TREATAS) on a bar by category
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"Segment2"}, Client[Segment]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Produit[Categorie], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]) ORDER BY Produit[Categorie]

queries.title: CALCULATE with a filter on a dimension attribute
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS by country, with DISTINCTCOUNT
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Pays], "CA", [CA], "Clients", [Nb clients]) ORDER BY Client[Pays]

queries.title: Cities of one country (country slicer)
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"Pays03"}, Client[Pays]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Ville], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Client[Ville]

queries.title: Table by customer name (Desktop's TOPN 501 over the dimension)
queries.dax: EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Client], "CA", [CA]), [CA], DESC, Client[Client], ASC) ORDER BY [CA] DESC, Client[Client]

queries.title: Between slicer on the dimension key (Desktop's FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES)))
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(VALUES(Client[ClientKey])), AND(Client[ClientKey] >= 1, Client[ClientKey] <= 1000000)) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Segment], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Client[Segment]

queries.title: CALCULATE with a range on the dimension key
Segment x age band, year slicer
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({2024}, Calendrier[Annee]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Segment], Client[TrancheAge], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]) ORDER BY Client[Segment], Client[TrancheAge]

queries.title: Average sales per customer by segment (AVERAGEX over VALUES)
queries.dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Segment], "Moyenne", AVERAGEX(VALUES(Client[ClientKey]), [CA])) ORDER BY Client[Segment]

queries.title: Customers over a threshold (FILTER over the dimension with a measure)
Row-by-row SUMX with RELATED to the big dimension
queries.dax: EVALUATE ROW("CA fidelite", SUMX(Ventes, IF(RELATED(Client[Fidelite]) = "Oui", Ventes[Montant])))

queries.title: Slicer on three customer names (high-cardinality text)
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"C0000042", "C0123456", "C1999999"}, Client[Client]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Calendrier[Annee], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA]) ORDER BY Calendrier[Annee]

queries.title: Active customers by segment in 2025
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({2025}, Calendrier[Annee]) EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Segment], __DS0FilterTable, "Clients", [Nb clients]) ORDER BY Client[Segment]

queries.title: Customer detail table of one city (TOPN 501)
queries.dax: DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = TREATAS({"Ville0042"}, Client[Ville]) EVALUATE TOPN(501, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Client[Client], Client[Segment], __DS0FilterTable, "CA", [CA], "Qte", [Qte]), Client[Client], ASC, Client[Segment], ASC) ORDER BY Client[Client], Client[Segment]
